_comment: Russian species names applied by build_species.py after eBird (locale=ru) and Wikidata: {slug: {"ru": name or null, "source": ...}}; null removes a wrong name. Only attested names: eBird names with an obvious typo fixed, or the title of the ru.wikipedia article about the species (checked via Wikidata sitelinks, 2026-09-27). Every name is also normalised in code: first letter upper case, names without Cyrillic letters (Latin binomials in Wikidata labels) dropped. Species checked with no ru.wikipedia article under a Russian title (left null): atlapetes-schistaceus, grallaria-saturata, grallaria-saltuensis, grallaria-quitensis, grallaria-alvarezi (article title is Latin), grallaria-alticola, dubusia-taeniata (article is titled with the genus, «Дюбузия»), tephrophilus-wetmorei, coeligena-bonapartei, heliangelus-clarisse, dacnis-egregia, myiothlypis-chlorophrys, rallus-aequatorialis (article title is Latin), atlapetes-crassus. Audit of 27.09 (second batch; eBird has no ru name, ru.wikipedia article absent or titled in Latin, left null): troglodytes-musculus, tyto-furcata (article «Tyto furcata»), cyphorhinus-dichrous, contopus-bogotensis, rhynchocyclus-aequinoctialis, gygis-candida, deconychura-pallida, myiopagis-cinerea, myiopagis-parambae, xenops-genibarbis, xenops-mexicanus, basileuterus-delattrii (article «Basileuterus delattrii»), phacellodomus-inornatus, acrochordopus-zeledoni, amaurospiza-aequatorialis, laniisoma-buckleyi, formicivora-intermedia (article «Formicivora intermedia»), setophaga-aestiva, chlorothraupis-frenata, automolus-virgatus, tunchiornis-ferrugineifrons, pachyramphus-salvini, furnarius-cinnamomeus (article «Furnarius cinnamomeus»), polioptila-bilineata, tolmomyias-viridiceps, cryptopipo-litae, ocreatus-peruanus. eBird ru names used as is: oxyura-ferruginea «Андская савка», mionectes-galbinus «Оливковый тираннчик» (eBird spells the whole genus «тираннчик»), lophornis-verreauxii «Кокетка-бабочка», zimmerius-parvus «Малый москитолов», larus-smithsonianus «Американская чайка» (ru.wikipedia: «Американская серебристая чайка»), myiodynastes-hemichrysus «Златобрюхий бентеви», myiobius-sulphureipygius «Желтогузый широкохвост». setophaga-petechia keeps «Жёлтая древесница» (ru.wikipedia title of the Setophaga petechia item).
